FW_A.name: Randomized Controlled Trial (RCT)
mandatory_elements: Exact Article Title as root heading
Clinical Bottom Line: Direct interpretive takeaway synthesizing efficacy, safety, and validity caveats

Results in Context: Primary outcome with point estimates, HR/RR, 95% CIs, p-values; absolute risk reduction (ARR) and NNT; secondary endpoints and oncology response criteria; patient-reported outcomes (PROs) with MID thresholds; key Grade 3-5 adverse events drawing from CONSORT Harms 2022

Assertive Critical Appraisal: RoB 2 overall judgment (Low / Some concerns / High) across all 5 domains; subgroup credibility audit; composite endpoint deconstruction; CONSORT reporting quality (allocation concealment, flow diagram)
Research Objective, Design & Setting: Hypothesis, trial design (parallel/adaptive), blinding, participant count, eligibility criteria, and setting
Bibliographic Data: Title, Authors, Journal, Year, DOI / PubMed ID
negative_constraints: NO medical disclaimers
NO conversational pleasantries or filler phrases
NO therapeutic mandates beyond what the study evaluated
Ground EVERY factual claim with an inline coordinate anchor (e.g. [Methods, Para 3], [Results, Table 2])

FW_B.name: Systematic Review & Meta-Analysis
mandatory_elements: Clinical Bottom Line: Direct interpretive summary integrating pooled effect estimates with evidence certainty
Results in Context: Summary of pooled results with exact effect sizes (OR/RR/HR) and 95% CIs; brief definition of statistical terms used; participant/study counts

Assertive Critical Appraisal: GRADE certainty ratings (High/Moderate/Low/Very Low) per critical outcome with downgrade reasons; Higgins I^2 heterogeneity magnitude and Cochran Q; publication bias assessment (funnel plot / Egger test); special consideration if overall pooled result is significant but individual studies are not; PRISMA reporting quality audit (flow diagram, search strategy)
Research Objective, Design & Setting: PICO question, databases searched, inclusion criteria
Bibliographic Data: Title, Authors, Journal, Year, DOI
negative_constraints: NO medical disclaimers
NO conversational filler
Ground every factual claim with an inline coordinate anchor

FW_C.name: Observational Study / Real-World Evidence
mandatory_elements: Clinical Bottom Line: Interpretive summary of observed associations, explicitly emphasizing that observational studies cannot prove causation due to residual confounding and bias

Results in Context: Main unadjusted and confounder-adjusted estimates (Odds Ratios, Relative Risks, Hazard Ratios) with 95% CIs for all key exposures/biomarkers; definitions of statistical metrics used; participant counts across follow-up stages

Assertive Critical Appraisal: STROBE bias critique (residual lifestyle confounding, reverse causality, survival selection, immortal time bias); STROBE confounding adjustment evaluation; RECORD assessment for routine health data / registry linkage (data provenance, ICD diagnostic coding, attrition); generalizability / clinical applicability

Research Objective, Design & Setting: Specific objectives and hypotheses; study design (prospective/retrospective cohort, case-control); setting, location, dates, participant eligibility and selection criteria
Bibliographic Data: Title, Authors, Journal, Year, DOI
negative_constraints: NO causal assertions (must frame findings strictly as associations)
NO medical disclaimers or conversational greetings
Ground every factual claim with an inline coordinate anchor

FW_D.name: Diagnostic Accuracy & Biomarker Study
mandatory_elements: Clinical Bottom Line: Interpretive summary of biomarker or diagnostic test utility and readiness for clinical implementation

Results in Context: Association effect sizes (HR/OR) and precision; diagnostic accuracy metrics (Sensitivity, Specificity, AUC/ROC, PPV, NPV) if applicable; clear distinction between prognostic and predictive utility; biomarker technology definition

Assertive Critical Appraisal: REMARK appraisal of biomarker claim (prognostic vs predictive; flag if predictive claim made without randomized comparison); audit of cut-point selection (pre-fixed vs optimal search); independent validation cohort check (internal cross-validation is insufficient); assay technical limits, LOD, and pre-analytical specimen handling; STARD verification bias audit; clinical applicability
Research Objective, Design & Setting: Marker examined, hypotheses, study design, case selection, clinical endpoints, patient characteristics
Bibliographic Data: Title, Authors, Journal, Year, DOI
negative_constraints: NO clinical utility claims without independent validation confirmation
NO medical disclaimers
Ground every factual claim with an inline coordinate anchor

FW_E.name: Clinical Trial Protocol & Statistical Analysis Plan
mandatory_elements: Clinical Bottom Line: Clear statement that this document is a study protocol detailing planned methodology for a future trial and contains NO clinical results; summary of research question significance
Planned Interventions and Outcomes: Detailed planned interventions for all groups; primary and secondary endpoints
Assertive Critical Appraisal: SPIRIT quality assessment; sample size power calculation critique; pre-specification of statistical analysis plan, missing data handling, and stopping boundaries
Research Objective, Design & Setting: Trial objectives, design, framework, allocation, randomization, blinding, eligibility criteria
Bibliographic Data: Title, Authors, Source, Date, Trial Registration number
negative_constraints: NO fictitious efficacy results
NO medical disclaimers
Ground every factual claim with an inline coordinate anchor

FW_F.name: Non-Inferiority Randomized Controlled Trial
mandatory_elements: Clinical Bottom Line: Direct interpretive summary clarifying whether non-inferiority was demonstrated, whether the new intervention is also similar or statistically inferior to standard, and both ITT and PP implications
Results in Context: Primary outcome with point estimates, 95% CIs, and comparison against the pre-specified margin (Delta); definition and rationale for non-inferiority design

Assertive Critical Appraisal: Non-inferiority margin critique (clinical justification, historical control retention, risk of biocreep); mandatory dual-analysis audit (ITT vs Per-Protocol divergence; flag if non-inferiority holds only in ITT); exact interpretation of 'non-inferior' vs equivalent or inferior
Research Objective, Design & Setting: Objective, stated non-inferiority hypothesis, design, allocation, blinding, setting, eligibility
Bibliographic Data: Title, Authors, Journal, Year, DOI
negative_constraints: NO acceptance of non-inferiority claims based exclusively on ITT
NO medical disclaimers
Ground every factual claim with an inline coordinate anchor

FW_G.name: Health Economic Evaluation
mandatory_elements: Clinical Bottom Line: Interpretive summary of cost-effectiveness and affordability at standard willingness-to-pay thresholds
Results in Context: Incremental Cost-Effectiveness Ratio (ICER); plain-language definitions of ICER, QALY, and DALY

Assertive Critical Appraisal: CHEERS reporting quality audit (analytic perspective, time horizon, annual discount rate applied to costs and benefits); model structure critique; deterministic and probabilistic sensitivity analyses
Research Objective, Design & Setting: Economic objective, evaluation type (CEA/CUA), model used, target population and setting
Bibliographic Data: Title, Authors, Journal, Year, DOI
negative_constraints: NO claims without explicit time horizon and discounting disclosure
NO medical disclaimers
Ground every factual claim with an inline coordinate anchor

FW_H.name: Narrative Review
mandatory_elements: Clinical Bottom Line: Direct summary of the authors' main argument, thesis, or clinical perspective
Key Themes & Evidence Summary: Scope of broad topics covered; main recommendations or assertions

Assertive Critical Appraisal: Explicit identification as Level 5 evidence / expert opinion; susceptibility to selection bias; full SANRA 6-domain score audit (Importance, Aims, Literature search description, Referencing consistency, Scientific reasoning, Data presentation)
Research Objective & Setting: Stated purpose of the narrative review
Bibliographic Data: Title, Authors, Journal, Year, DOI
negative_constraints: NO presentation of narrative claims as Level 1 evidence
NO medical disclaimers
Ground every factual claim with an inline coordinate anchor
